scan.title: Scan this code on the panel
scan.description: On the panel, open Settings and tap **Scan QR code**. If it cannot read it, type the address `{url}` and the code `{code}`. The code is valid for 10 minutes and works once. Press Submit when the panel says it is connected.

error.not_scanned: The panel has not used the code yet. If it expired, this is a new one.

abort.already_configured: This panel already exists: remove it first to add it again.
abort.no_internal_url: Home Assistant has no internal URL: set one in Settings > System > Network.

init.title: Panel settings
init.description: The panel applies these as soon as you save them. MQTT carries the doorbell, the sensors and the siren: without it those stop too.

features.name: Features
features.description: Turn off what this panel should not do. What is on but has no data below does nothing.

data_description.sip: Registers with the intercoms, so the panel can answer the door and talk to it. Off: it unregisters, and DMSS is not affected.
data_description.cameras: Shows the cameras in the panel's menu, with their video.
data_description.weather: Shows the weather and forecast next to the clock. Needs a weather entity.
data_description.mqtt: Connects to the broker. It carries the doorbell ring, the sensors, the siren and the droid's state: off, all of them stop. Needs a broker address.
data_description.sensors: Publishes light, battery, battery temperature and charging. Off: Home Assistant removes those entities.
data_description.siren: Lets Home Assistant sound the panel's siren at full volume. Off: it removes the entity and ignores the command.

mqtt.name: MQTT broker
mqtt.description: The broker the panel connects to directly.

data_description.intercoms: Intercoms the panel registers with over SIP. The name must match the one the doorbell automation publishes to marc2d/doorbell/<name>.
data_description.cameras: Cameras shown in the panel's menu. Choose an intercom to offer Talk on that camera.
data_description.weather_entity: The weather entity shown next to the clock.
